name: Franklin Resources (Franklin Templeton)
description: Franklin Templeton manages $1.66 trillion (September 2025; $1.79 trillion at June 2026) through a collection of specialist managers: Western Asset (bonds), ClearBridge, Brandywine, Putnam, Royce, Clarion Partners (real estate), Lexington Partners (private equity secondaries), Benefit Street Partners (private credit), among others. It earns an annual percentage fee on assets, plus large sales, distribution and shareholder-servicing fees from its funds (about 22 percent of revenue), most of which it passes through to the brokers and advisers who sell its funds. Alternatives (private credit, real estate, secondaries) are 16 percent of AUM and growing; bonds fell 21 percent in FY2025 after outflows.

employees.note: About 9,800 employees (about 10,200 a year earlier) in offices in over 30 countries.

businessLines.name: Equity
businessLines.how: Annual percentage fee on equity assets managed in funds, separate accounts and ETFs (Franklin Equity Group, ClearBridge, Putnam, Royce, Templeton and others); 41 percent of AUM, +9 percent in FY2025.

businessLines.name: Fixed Income
businessLines.how: Annual percentage fee on bond assets (Western Asset, Brandywine, Franklin Templeton Fixed Income); AUM fell 21 percent in FY2025 (from 556.4 to 438.7).

businessLines.name: Alternative
businessLines.how: Fees on private credit (Benefit Street Partners), real estate (Clarion Partners), private equity secondaries (Lexington Partners) and hedge/other funds; typically higher fee rates and long lock-ups; 16 percent of AUM.

businessLines.name: Multi-Asset
businessLines.how: Fee on balanced and solutions portfolios (Franklin Templeton Investment Solutions).

businessLines.name: Cash Management
businessLines.how: Small fee on money market and cash funds; lowest fee rate.
